top_signals.title: Venture Global Is in Talks to Sell US LNG to More Chinese Buyers
top_signals.summary: US liquefied natural gas exporter Venture Global Inc. is in talks to sell the fuel to additional Chinese buyers as the Iran war roils global shipments, spurring China to seek to diversify its sources of supply.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: French Fiscal Concerns Bring Home Painful Risk Premium
top_signals.summary:
After decades of budget deficits and steadily rising debt, markets are putting a new price on French risk. 
Investors are charging much more to hold government bonds, the stock market is under pressure and the cost of insuring bank bonds against default has jumped. 
The euro fell to its weakest level since May 2025 on Monday, reflecting fears that upheaval will spill beyond France’s border.
Ozan Tarman, Vice Chair: Global Macro at Deutsche Bank, discusses the growing debt pressures across Europe and contagion risks. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Potential liquidity or banking-system instability affecting financial conditions.
